title: Easter Carrot Garden Cupcakes
shortDescription: Spiced carrot cupcakes with cream cheese frosting piped into grass swirls, ready in 25 minutes prep and 18 minutes bake.
description: These carrot cupcakes taste like a warm spring morning. I mix real shredded carrot into a cinnamon batter, then bake until the tops spring back.
ingredients: mini chocolate eggs or jelly beans, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a muffin pan with 12 paper liners.
Whisk flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt in a bowl.
In a separate bowl, beat eggs, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until light.
Add oil and vanilla to the egg mix. Stir until smooth.
Fold in the flour mix just until no dry streaks remain.
Fold in shredded carrot and drained pineapple gently.
Divide batter evenly among liners, filling each about two thirds full.
Bake 16 to 18 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool in the pan 5 minutes, then move to a rack.
Beat cream cheese and butter together until smooth and creamy.
Add powdered sugar in two batches, beating well after each addition.
Tint the frosting green with gel color, mixing until even.
Once cupcakes are fully cool, pipe frosting using a grass tip in short upward strokes to cover the tops. Add mini chocolate eggs on top.
tips: Shred carrots on the fine side of a box grater so they bake soft, not stringy.
Press drained pineapple with a paper towel to remove extra liquid, or your batter turns runny.
Chill frosting 10 minutes before piping if your kitchen is warm, it holds the grass texture better.
Use a grass piping tip (Wilton 233) and short quick strokes straight up for the best garden look.

faq.question: Can I make these carrot cupcakes ahead for Easter brunch?
faq.answer: Yes, bake the cupcakes up to 2 days ahead and store unfrosted in an airtight container. Frost the morning you serve them so the grass piping stays sharp.

faq.question: Why is my grass piping not holding its shape?
faq.answer: Your frosting is likely too soft. Chill it for 10 to 15 minutes, then re-whip briefly before piping again.

faq.question: Can I skip the pineapple in the batter?
faq.answer: You can, but the cupcakes will be slightly less moist. If you skip it, add 1 extra tablespoon of oil to keep texture right.

faq.question: What piping tip gives the best grass effect for these cupcakes?
faq.answer: A Wilton 233 multi opening tip works best. Hold the bag straight up and pipe short, quick strokes to build texture.

conclusion: These Easter carrot garden cupcakes make a fun centerpiece for spring brunch. The grass piping is easier than it looks once you get the wrist motion down.
